Translation: Glory be to Him who wears honor and dignity

Arabic text: سُبْحَانَ مَنْ تَعَطَّفَ بِالْمَجْدِ وَتَكَرَّمَ بِهِ
Translation: Glory be to Him who is adorned with magnificence and is generous with it

Arabic text: سُبْحَانَ مَنْ لَا يَنْبَغِيْ التَّسْبِيْحُ إِلَّا لَهُ
Translation: Glory be to Him whom none deserves glorification except Him

Arabic text: سُبْحَانَ مَنْ اَحْصَى كُلَّ شَيْءٍ عِلْمُهُ
Translation: Glory be to Him whose knowledge encompasses all things
Glory be to the Possessor of favor and blessings
Glory be to the Possessor of power and generosity

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّيْ اَسْئَلُكَ بِمَعَاقِدِ الْعِزِّ مِنْ عَرْشِكَ
Translation: O Allah, I ask You by the positions of honor of Your throne
And the ultimate mercy in Your Book
Which are complete in truth and justice
Send blessings upon Muhammad and his household
